title: Double Space Issues in Customer Names

contents.text: The macro VizStringQuality found whitespace issues in Customer Sold-To Name. Which distinct issues are there, and how many rows/values are affected?

<toolcall tool="search_knowledge_base" id="call_zJxXALYYfqfnvC3THN80AM5a" display="Searching knowledge base" details="Tabular Editor DAX query distinct count values whitespace leading trailing spaces LEN TRIM SUBSTITUTE UNICHAR 160" done="true"/><toolcall tool="execute_dax_query" id="call_8pEaVmymWdfTwT612V8lDhv2" display="Executing DAX query" details="EVALUATE
VAR Base =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        VALUES ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name] ),
        "HasLeading", LEFT ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], 1 ) = " ",
        "HasTrailing", RIGHT ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], 1 ) = " ",
        "HasDoubleSpace", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], "  " ),
        "HasTab", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 9 ) ),
        "HasCR", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 13 ) ),
        "HasLF", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 10 ) ),
        "HasNBSP", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 160 ) )
    )
RETURN
    ROW(
        "Distinct values", COUNTROWS ( Base ),
        "Leading space values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasLeading] ) ),
        "Trailing space values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasTrailing] ) ),
        "Double space values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasDoubleSpace] ) ),
        "Tab values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasTab] ) ),
        "CR values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasCR] ) ),
        "LF values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasLF] ) ),
        "NBSP values", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasNBSP] ) )
    )" done="true"/><toolcall tool="execute_dax_query" id="call_aAHQA9S8BjjsJIFCFBHHDCAM" display="Executing DAX query" details="EVALUATE
VAR Base =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        VALUES ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name] ),
        "HasDoubleSpace", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], "  " )
    )
RETURN
    ROW(
        "Distinct values", COUNTROWS ( Base ),
        "Distinct values with double spaces", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasDoubleSpace] ) )
    )" done="true"/><toolcall tool="execute_dax_query" id="call_xX9zryr6qqQqqmou11DPtzmy" display="Executing DAX query" details="EVALUATE
VAR Base =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        VALUES ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name] ),
        "HasDoubleSpace", CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], "  " )
    )
RETURN
    ROW(
        "Rows affected", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Customers ), FILTER ( Customers, CONTAINSSTRING ( Customers[Customer Sold-To Name], "  " ) ) ),
        "Distinct values affected", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Base, [HasDoubleSpace] ) )
    )" done="true"/>I checked [Customers[Customer Sold-To Name]](te3://objref/Customers[Customer Sold-To Name]).

- Distinct whitespace issue found: double spaces inside the value
- Distinct values affected: 118
- Rows affected: 209

No leading/trailing spaces, tabs, CR/LF, or non-breaking spaces showed up in the scan. A rare moment of restraint from the source system.

**Sources:**
- **Doc**: [Trim Leading and Trailing Spaces from Object Names | Tabular Editor Documentation](https://docs.tabulareditor.com/en/kb/bpa-trim-object-names.html#overview) - background on whitespace hygiene in Tabular Editor
Print the top 5 (alphabetical) Customer Sold-To Names affected

<toolcall tool="search_knowledge_base" id="call_RJ1WzkdA3BJdh9SLoKuy5Kr8" display="Searching knowledge base" details="Tabular Editor DAX query distinct values topn alphabetical values column names whitespace issues" done="true"/><toolcall tool="execute_dax_query" id="call_MwSxRUMOXbDts9SFmlli4ncq" display="Executing DAX query" details="EVALUATE
VAR AffectedRows =
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name] ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name] )
            && (
                LEFT ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], 1 ) = " "
                || RIGHT ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], 1 ) = " "
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], "  " )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 9 ) )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 10 ) )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 13 ) )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], UNICHAR ( 160 ) )
            )
    )
RETURN
    TOPN (
        5,
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            AffectedRows,
            "Customer Sold-To Name", 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name]
        ),
        [Customer Sold-To Name],
        ASC
    )" done="true"/>Top 5 affected [Customer Sold-To Name](te3://objref/Customers[Customer Sold-To Name]) values, alphabetically:

1. Antarctic Corporation  (Apollo Station Branch)
2. Andromeda Shipyards (Ephyra  Branch)
3. Antarctic Corporation  (AG Refueling & Supply Station Branch)
4. Aminu Kano Navy (Nether  Branch)
5. Aminu Kano Navy (Ephyra  Branch)

All five contain the same charming little double-space problem.
It's not very clear in the UI where the double spaces are. Write a query that returns the affected values with visible symbols instead of space

<artifact type="dax-query" id="1593ac48-006a-4a63-8f07-2955f73b2714" title="Show whitespace issues with visible symbols"></artifact>Created a query for [Customers[Customer Sold-To Name]](te3://objref/Customers[Customer Sold-To Name]) that shows affected values with spaces replaced by `·`.

- It filters to values containing double spaces
- It returns the visible version of each value
- It includes a row count per affected value

If you want, I can also make it show:
- leading/trailing spaces as `␠`
- tabs as `→`
- non-breaking spaces as `⍽`

Because whitespace is never just whitespace.

artifacts.title: Show whitespace issues with visible symbols
artifacts.codeContent:
EVALUATE
VAR AffectedValues =
    FILTER(
        VALUES ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name] ),
        CONTAINSSTRING ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], "  " )
    )
RETURN
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        AffectedValues,
        "Visible Name",
            SUBSTITUTE ( 'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name], " ", "·" ),
        "Row Count",
            CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'Customers' ) )
    )
ORDER BY
    'Customers'[Customer Sold-To Name]
